In this video, Amit leads a fun stretching session designed specifically for children. This routine focuses on improving flexibility, building strength, and boosting overall fitness through gentle yet effective yoga poses. Whether they’re starting their day or need a quick movement break, these exercises are perfect for keeping kids energized and focused.
What’s included in this routine:
Gentle full-body stretches for flexibility.
Easy yoga poses for balance and coordination.
Fun movements to improve physical fitness and posture.
